task.description: WF-02 Step 2c HARD GATE: security review of lib/letflow/definitions/export_import.ex (branch feature/WF02-REQ034-20260817, diff git diff main...HEAD). This module reads/writes process_definitions (tenant-scoped) by delegating entirely to REQ-030's get_by_id/2 and create/2 -- confirm the delegation is total (no direct tenant-schema access, no tenant_id trust-the-caller pattern, no bypass of the tenant_id derivation REQ-025/030/037 established).
acceptance_criteria: Scope test performed: confirm this diff touches a tenant-data path per docs/agents/instructions/security-invariants.md's applicability notes
For each of INV-1..INV-8: determine APPLIES or NOT-APPLICABLE against this diff, with reasoning
For each APPLIES invariant, the verification check actually run (not asserted)

Specific check: import/3 must not accept or trust a caller-supplied tenant_id anywhere -- confirm create_attrs never includes a :tenant_id key (matches design INV -- tenant_id must come from create/2's own derivation, same as REQ-025/030/037's established pattern per docs/migration/decisions/0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md's write-time addendum)

result.summary: Scope test: IN SCOPE. lib/letflow/definitions/export_import.ex (new file, 137 lines) is response-shaping/lookup-by-id code over process_definitions, a tenant-scoped table -- export/2 wraps get_by_id/2 (lookup-by-ID), import/3 wraps create/2 (write path). Reviewed the actual diff (git diff main...HEAD -- lib/letflow/definitions/export_import.ex, new-file) and the full module body directly, plus create/2 and get_by_id/2 in lib/letflow/definitions.ex (lines 310-366) that it delegates to. Findings: (1) grep for 'tenant_id' and 'prefix' inside export_import.ex returns zero hits -- the module never references, accepts, or threads a tenant_id/prefix value of its own; export/2 and import/3 both take opts() = [prefix: String.t()] verbatim and pass it straight through to Definitions.get_by_id/2 and Definitions.create/2 unmodified. (2) import/3's create_attrs map (lines 122-129) is {name, version, description, graph, created_by} -- no :tenant_id key, confirmed by both reading the literal map construction and the grep in (1). create/2 independently rejects any caller-supplied :tenant_id via reject_key/4 (line 335) and derives tenant_id from opts[:prefix] via TenantProvisioning.tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 (line 337) before insert_definition/3 writes it -- export_import.ex has no path around this. (3) export/2's read is a single 'with {:ok, definition} <- Definitions.get_by_id(id, opts) do' -- get_by_id/2 (definitions.ex:356-366) does Repo.get(ProcessDefinition, uuid, prefix: prefix), i.e. the lookup is confined to the tenant schema named by opts[:prefix]; a row belonging to another tenant's schema is not reachable through this prefix and returns {:error, :not_found} identically to a genuinely nonexistent id (same code path, same case clause) -- no cross-tenant leak, no id-only global lookup. (4) grep -n 'Repo\.' export_import.ex: zero hits -- no direct/bypass DB access, 100% delegation to already-reviewed REQ-030 functions as the design doc claims. (5) grep -n 'Repo.query' export_import.ex: zero hits (INV-7). (6) grep -n 'System.get_env' and secret-literal heuristic grep against export_import.ex: zero hits -- module touches no secret material (INV-4 trivially satisfied). (7) grep -n '^\s*{:ok, .*} = ' export_import.ex: zero hits -- export/2 uses a with/do with no else (falls through on any non-{:ok,_} value from get_by_id/2, matching export_error()'s declared type), import/3 uses a case covering both the matching-version and actual-version branches; no bare pattern match that can raise on realistic input (INV-8).

invariant_table.title: Tenant data isolation
invariant_table.reasoning: process_definitions is a tenant-scoped table (S1 done, S2 migrations exist per 0003-ecto-schema-strategy.md decided status). (a) both export/2 and import/3 delegate their only DB-reaching calls (get_by_id/2, create/2) which are prefix-scoped (Repo.get(..., prefix: prefix) / insert via prefix); no query bypasses :prefix. (b) no migration added by this diff, no new table. (c) tenant_id is never a key export_import.ex constructs or accepts -- confirmed by grep (zero hits for 'tenant_id' in the file) and by reading create/2's reject_key/4 + TenantProvisioning-derived tenant_id, which import/3's attrs map cannot circumvent since it never sets that key at all.
